title: Utensil
summary: UTEN'SIL, noun [This seems to be formed on the participle of the Latin utor.] An instrument; that which is used; particularly, an instrument or vessel used in a kitchen, or in domestic and farming bus

inlines.v: UTEN'SIL, noun [This seems to be formed on the participle of the Latin utor.] An instrument; that which is used; particularly, an instrument or vessel used in a kitchen, or in domestic and farming business.
